All 18 rules searched and the plan is submitted.

Summary of what the search turned up:

- **Located and responsive (13 rules):** LOL-CAP (§16.5 consequential-damages disclaimer, no aggregate cap found), INDEMN (mutual §§16.1–16.3), NONCOMPETE (§8.2 Exclusivity of Efforts plus at-will termination tail), EXCLUSIVITY (Article IX Array-as-supply-source, §8.2), T4C (§§13.2–13.4), RENEWAL (§13.1 royalty-term-linked term, no evergreen), GOVLAW (§18.3 plus ICC arbitration with a flipping seat), ASSIGN (§18.11-type clause, §18.10 Change in Control), IP (§11.1 ownership, §2.6 grant-back, Article XIV reversion), LICENSE (§§2.1–2.2 grants), AUDIT (§7.4 records inspection, §4.6(d) site audits), LD (§14.3 — runs in our favour), WARRANTY (Article XV reps plus broad implied-warranty disclaimer), TRANSITION (Article XIV wind-down regime).
- **Likely absent (4 rules):** MFN, NOSOLICIT, INSURANCE, MINCOMMIT — each searched with multiple phrasings; the only hits were incidental or ran in our favour.

Two points worth flagging to the reviewing workers: no aggregate liability cap surfaced anywhere in Article XVI, and there is no insurance covenant despite the indemnity and recall obligations. Both warrant confirmation on the paginated read before being treated as settled.
